title: In the kitchen
author: Shénbǐ
description: Bowls, chopsticks, noodles and a big fridge for your world, plus 好吃 (tasty) and 做饭 (to cook), and 14 sentences to read.

words.hint: 石 (stone) on the left: a bowl is hard like stone.
竹 (bamboo) on top of 筷: chopsticks are made of bamboo.
勺 looks like a spoon with a drop of soup in it.
刀 is a picture of a blade with its handle.
钅 (metal) on the left: a wok is made of metal.
皿 (dish) at the bottom of 盘: something to put food on.
米 is rice grains scattered around; 饭 has 饣 (food) on the left.
面 noodles + 条, the measure word for long thin things.
氵 (water) on the left: soup is mostly water.
冰 ice + 箱 box: an ice box.
好 good + 吃 eat: good to eat.
做 make + 饭 meal: make a meal.
